overview.en:
Use Perfect Corp’s YouCam tools for image and video editing, beauty visualization and virtual try-on.

Prepare product or portrait imagery from a clear visual brief and source assets. Specify the intended output and review the proposed edits before finalizing.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
使用玩美移动 YouCam 进行图片与视频编辑、美妆效果预览和虚拟试穿。

根据明确视觉简报与源素材准备商品图或人像效果，说明预期输出，并在定稿前审阅拟议编辑。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a clean product image from this source photo.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据这张源照片准备干净的商品图。

starterPrompts.en: Create a visual preview for this product presentation brief.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这份商品展示简报创建视觉预览。

starterPrompts.en: Revise this image according to the supplied feedback.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据提供的反馈修改这张图。

descriptions.en: Use YouCam in Ghast. Use Perfect Corp’s YouCam tools for image and video editing, beauty visualization and virtual try-on. 使用玩美移动 YouCam 进行图片与视频编辑、美妆效果预览和虚拟试穿。
